[Problem]{.card-kicker} **minimum depth of a binary tree** [LC 111 · Minimum Depth of Binary Tree](https://leetcode.com/problems/minimum-depth-of-binary-tree/){difficulty="Easy"}

`1 + min` of both sides treats a missing child as a leaf of depth $0$, so a right spine of five nodes reports $1$. Recurse into a side only when that child exists. Level order can stop at the first leaf and never visit the rest of a wide tree.
